name: creator-intake
description: Public-safe intake plugin for deciding whether an AgeVolt AI request should become a marketplace, plugin, skill, KB, MCP, rule, personal rule, script, or no new artifact.

interface.longDescription: Creator Intake je public-safe vstupna brana pre AgeVolt Marketplace Creator. Pri poziadavkach na nove marketplaces, pluginy, skills, KB, MCP, pravidla alebo migraciu najprv rozhodne spravny typ artefaktu, najde lokalny SharePoint AI Agent root a pripravi artifact proposal namiesto nahodnej implementacie.
defaultPrompt: Rozhodni, aky AgeVolt AI artefakt mam vytvorit.
Vytvor artifact proposal pre novy skill alebo plugin.
Skontroluj, ci tato poziadavka patri do marketplace, pluginu, skillu, KB alebo MCP.
